question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT 
        d.year,
        d.constructor_id,
        ds.driver_id,
        SUM(ds.points) as driver_total_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN drives d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id AND ds.race_id BETWEEN d.first_round AND d.last_round
    GROUP BY d.year, d.constructor_id, ds.driver_id
),
best_drivers AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        constructor_id,
        MAX(driver_total_points) as best_driver_points
    FROM driver_points
    GROUP BY year, constructor_id
),
constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.year,
        ct.constructor_id,
        ct.constructor_points,
        bd.best_driver_points,
        ct.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_totals ct
    JOIN best_drivers bd ON ct.year = bd.year AND ct.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id
),
constructor_max AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, MAX(combined_points) as max_combined
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY constructor_id
),
top3_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, max_combined
    FROM constructor_max
    ORDER BY max_combined DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    t3.constructor_id,
    c.name as constructor_name,
    combined.year,
    combined.constructor_points,
    combined.best_driver_points,
    combined.combined_points
FROM top3_constructors t3
JOIN combined ON t3.constructor_id = combined.constructor_id 
    AND combined.combined_points = t3.max_combined
JOIN constructors c ON combined.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY t3.max_combined DESC, combined.combined_points DESC
